question: How much narrower should the shank tip be than its root measure?
premises: The shank root measure is one third part.
The shank tip width is reduced.
The reduction is by that one third measure.
inference: The width at the shank tip should be one third less than the shank root measure.
plain_english: The width at the tip of the shank should be one third less than at the root of the shank.
